message.content: {"draft":"Row-parallel softmax. One program per row. Load row with -inf mask, max, exp, sum, divide. Store masked. FP32 math. Fresh contiguous output. Preserve input.","plan":"Allocate out. Grid rows. Kernel: pid row, arange cols, mask, load -inf, max, exp, sum, div, store. Constexpr block pow2 >= cols. FP32 compute. Return out.","code_lines":["import torch","import triton","import triton.language as tl","","","@triton.jit","def _softmax_kernel(","    input_ptr,","    output_ptr,","    n_cols,","    BLOCK_SIZE: tl.constexpr,","    IS_BF16: tl.constexpr,","):","    row = tl.program_id(0)","    col_offsets = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE)","    mask = col_offsets < n_cols","    in_ptrs = input_ptr + row * n_cols + col_offsets","    row_vals = tl.load(in_ptrs, mask=mask, other=-float('inf'))","    row_f32 = row_vals.to(tl.float32)","    row_max = tl.max(row_f32, axis=0)","    exp_vals = tl.exp(row_f32 - row_max)","    denom = tl.sum(exp_vals, axis=0)","    out_vals = exp_vals / denom","    if IS_BF16:","        out_vals = out_vals.to(tl.bfloat16)","    out_ptrs = output_ptr + row * n_cols + col_offsets","    tl.store(out_ptrs, out_vals, mask=mask)","","","def run(x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:","    assert x.is_cuda and x.dim() == 2 and x.is_contiguous()","    n_rows, n_cols = x.shape","    out = torch.empty_like(x)","    BLOCK_SIZE = triton.next_power_of_2(n_cols)","    grid = (n_rows,)","    _softmax_kernel[grid](x, out, n_cols, BLOCK_SIZE=BLOCK_SIZE, IS_BF16=(x.dtype == torch.bfloat16))","    return out"]}
